title: Interior & Exterior Painting in Fort Bend County | Free Estimates
description: Transform your home with expert interior and exterior painting in Fort Bend County. Serving Sugar Land, Richmond & beyond. Free estimates from The Proud
author: Chris Petkau
content:
Is your home in need of a refresh? Whether you’re looking to brighten up your interior spaces or add curb appeal with a stunning exterior update, The Proud Paintbrush is here to help.

We’re proud to offer professional house painting services across Fort Bend County — including Sugar Land, Missouri City, Richmond, and Rosenberg — with free, no-obligation estimates on every job.

🏠 Interior Painting Services

From cozy bedrooms to full open-concept living areas, a fresh coat of paint can transform your entire home.

What We Paint Indoors:

  • Walls & ceilings

  • Trim, doors, and baseboards

  • Cabinets and built-ins

  • Accent walls

  • Stairwells & hallways

💡 Need help picking colors? We offer color consultations to help you choose the perfect palette.

🏡 Exterior Painting Services

Texas weather can be tough on your home’s exterior. A high-quality paint job not only boosts curb appeal but also protects your property from moisture, sun, and heat.

We Paint All Exterior Surfaces:

  • Brick, stucco, and siding

  • Fascia, soffits, and trim

  • Garage doors and shutters

  • Front doors and porches

  • Fences, pergolas, and detached structures

📍 Serving All of Fort Bend County

We proudly serve homeowners in:

  • Sugar Land

  • Missouri City

  • Richmond

  • Rosenberg

  • Stafford

  • And surrounding areas

As a locally-owned company, we understand the unique architectural styles and HOA guidelines throughout Fort Bend — and we tailor every project accordingly.

💵 Transparent Pricing & Free Estimates

We believe in fair, honest pricing— no hidden fees, no surprise charges.

When you request a quote, we’ll:

  1. Visit your home in person

  2. Provide a detailed written estimate

  3. Explain your options clearly

  4. Work around your schedule and budget

✅ 100% Free. No obligation. Just helpful, professional advice.

✔️ Locally owned and operated
